blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.
blocks.zh: 互动场景探索需要频繁的观看更新,尽管小相机运动保留了大部分可见内容. 然而,常规的3D高斯镀板使每个目标视图都变得不为所动,使得这个图像没有被利用。 重新使用已制作的图像提供了一个替代方案。 仅靠几何warping无法恢复新曝光的内容,对深度错误仍然敏感. 我们提出一个场景框架,用相对可控的RGB-D图像再利用来取代反复渲染附近视图的场景渲染. 几何warping使用深度和相对姿势来传送源内容,而轻量级的多尺度网络则预测RGB残基来修正文物并推断缺失的外观. 缓存源特性进一步减少重复计算. 关于GS-resources,剩余改进改进后PSNR改进0.72~d B 超越纯粹的扭曲;对捕捉到的场景的评价显示出低查询的空闲性。 这种将场景渲染从局部视图更新中分离出来的做法支持响应场景探索,在增强和虚拟现实中可能应用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Novel view synthesis enables interactive exploration of reconstructed scenes. Conventional scene renderers generate an image for each requested camera pose. During local navigation, however, small camera motions often leave substantial visible content shared with a previously rendered image. This overlap creates an opportunity to reuse the source image, which already contains much of the appearance needed by a nearby target. The central question is how to exploit this overlap while accounting for the image changes introduced by camera motion.
blocks.zh: 小说取景合成可以对被重建的场景进行互动探索. 常规场景渲染器为每个被请求的相机姿势生成图像. 然而,在局部导航期间,相机的小相机运动往往会留下大量可见内容,与先前制作的相片共用. 这种重叠创造了重用源图像的机会,源图像已经包含附近目标所需的很多外观. 中心问题是如何利用这种重叠,同时考虑相机运动带来的图像变化.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Local view synthesis. 3DGS renders each target view from the scene representation (top). Our method reuses a rendered RGB-D image through relative-pose-guided warping and RGB residual correction (bottom).
blocks.zh: 图1:地方取景综合. 3DGS让每个目标视图从场景表现(上). 我们的方法通过相对的自带导引发和RGB剩余校正(下方)再利用一个已成型的RGB-D图像.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Framework overview. Depth and relative pose guide warping, while a multiscale decoder combines cached source features and geometric cues to predict an RGB residual. Adding this residual to the warped image yields the target prediction. Dashed red arrows indicate training supervision.
blocks.zh: 图 2:框架概述。 深度和相对姿势为向导扭曲,而多尺度的解码器结合了缓存的源特性和几何提示来预测RGB后遗症. 在被扭曲的图像中加入这个剩余部分会产生目标预测. 被打成红箭表示训练监督.

blocks.en: 1.1 Scene Rendering and Image Reuse
blocks.zh: 1.1 场景渲染和图像再用

blocks.en: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) integrate radiance along camera rays, whereas 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) projects and composites Gaussian primitives [ 11 , 9 ] . Both reuse a persistent scene representation, but conventional target queries still require a new rendering pass. Image-based approaches exploit source observations through learned transformations [ 25 , 12 , 3 ] , multiplane representations [ 24 , 16 , 5 , 17 ] , projected features [ 20 , 22 , 18 ] , or learned multiview blending [ 6 ] . We focus on synthesizing nearby views from an available rendered RGB-D image.
blocks.zh: 神经辐射场(NERF)将光线与相机射线相融合,而3D高斯平板(3DGS)项目和复合材料高斯原始[11,9]. 两次再利用都是一种持续的场景表现,但传统的目标查询仍然需要一个新的渲染通道. 基于图像的方法通过学习的转变[25、12、3]、多行星的表示[24、16、5、17]、预测特征[20、22、18]或学习的多视图混合[6]利用源观测。 我们专注于从现有的RGB-D图像中合成附近的观点。

blocks.en: 1.2 Pose-Guided Warping and Residual Refinement
blocks.zh: 1.2 Pose-Guided Warping和残留物改进

blocks.en: Given depth, intrinsics, and relative pose, geometric warping establishes correspondences and transports observed structure [ 7 ] . However, newly exposed regions lack source observations, while depth inaccuracies, resampling, and view-dependent appearance introduce further errors. CheapNVS learns flow, masks, and inpainting for RGB-D synthesis [ 4 ] ; NeuralPassthrough combines depth-based warping with two-view fusion [ 21 ] . Layered inpainting completes hidden content for single-image view synthesis [ 13 , 8 ] . Reusing a single rendered image therefore requires preserving transported detail while correcting regions where correspondence is unreliable or absent.
blocks.zh: 由于深度、内在和相对姿势,几何相拼法建立了通信和运输观测结构[7]。 然而,新暴露出的区域缺乏源观测,而深度不准确、再取样和视线外观则造成进一步错误。 廉价的NVS为 RGB-D 合成学习流量、口罩和油漆 [ 4]; 神经Passcover结合了以深度为主的打分和双视聚变[21]. 分层涂装完成单相图视图合成的隐藏内容 [13, 8]. 因此,要重新使用单一的成像,就需要保留运输的细节,同时纠正通信不可靠或缺失的区域。

blocks.en: 1.3 Motivations and Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.3 动机和贡献

blocks.en: We address this problem by separating geometric transport from residual appearance correction (Fig. 1 ). For each static scene, we train a model that refines a pose-guided warp through multiscale RGB residual prediction. Image and geometry guidance retain spatial detail, while cached source features support repeated target queries without invoking the scene renderer. Our main contributions are: • We present a relative-pose-guided framework for local view synthesis by reusing rendered RGB-D images. • We design a multiscale residual network with source feature reuse and full-resolution RGB/geometry cues. • We assess reconstruction quality, query cost, and viewpoint range on real and rendered scenes, with component ablations on rendered data.
blocks.zh: 我们通过区分几何运输与剩余外观修正来解决这一问题(图1)。 对于每个静态场景,我们训练一个模型,通过多尺度的RGB残余预测来精炼出一个姿势制导的曲率. 图像和几何向导保留了空间细节,而被缓存的源特性则支持了重复的目标查询而无需引用场景渲染器. 我们的主要贡献是: 我们通过重用渲染的 RGB-D 图像,为局部视图合成呈现出相对可控的导出框架 。 我们设计了一个具有源特性再利用和全分辨率RGB/几何提示的多尺度残余网络。 我们评估重建质量、查询成本和真实场景的视野范围,同时对已提供的数据进行分解。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate rendered-image reuse through reconstruction quality, component ablations, and viewpoint changes. The following experiments assess how geometric transport and residual refinement support local synthesis, together with the computational cost of source reuse.
blocks.zh: 我们通过重建质量、组件和观点的改变来评估图像的再利用。 以下实验评估了几何迁移和残留精细化如何支持局部合成,以及源再利用的计算成本.

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate rendered RGB-D data from GS-render (three Mip-NeRF 360 scenes [ 1 ] ) and Blender (Barcelona Pavilion), alongside captured 7-Scenes data [ 14 ] . Images are 640 × 480 640\times 480 , with disjoint source splits and viewpoint changes up to 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} ; rendered tests include held-out motion directions. Our models use per-scene Adam [ 10 ] training ( 10 − 3 10^{-3} ) and validation-selected checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了GS-resanders(三个Mip-NERF 360场景[1])和Blender(巴塞罗那展馆)提供的RGB-D数据,以及捕获的7-场景数据[14]。 相片为640×480 640\times 480,有脱节源分出,视线变化可达15×××15×Circ};制成的测试包括被搁置的运动方向. 我们的型号使用每个场景的亚当[10]训练(10-3 10-X+3])和验证选定的检查站.

blocks.en: Baselines are reimplemented CheapNVS [ 4 ] , pretrained AdaMPI32 [ 5 ] , and scene-trained 3DGS [ 9 ] , with different training regimes and inputs. PSNR, SSIM [ 19 ] , and LPIPS [ 23 ] use identical held-out targets and equal averaging across sources, angular bins, and scenes. Timing uses an RTX 5090, FP32, batch one, and CUDA synchronization; memory excludes metrics and target RGB.
blocks.zh: 基线是重新执行ChoapNVS[4],预先培训AdaMPI32[5],现场培训3DGS[9],培训制度和投入各不相同。 PSNR, SSIM [19], 和LPIPS [23] 使用相同的被扣出的目标, 并平等平均在来源,角箱,和场景之间. Timing使用RTX 5090,FP32,第1批,CUDA同步;内存排除了度量衡和目标RGB.

blocks.en: 3.2 Local View Synthesis Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 本地视图综合结果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that Ours achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM among the evaluated methods in each domain. On GS-render, it exceeds AdaMPI32 by 1.00 dB PSNR, supporting reuse of an existing rendering for nearby target views. This advantage also holds on Blender, while 7-Scenes tests the framework with captured RGB-D inputs. AdaMPI32 nevertheless achieves lower LPIPS on 7-Scenes.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,我们在每个领域评估的方法中实现了最高的PSNR和SSIM. 在GS-resources上,它比AdaMPI32多出1.00 dB PSNR,支持为附近的目标视图再利用已存在的渲染. 这一优势也维持在Blender上,而7-Scase则用所捕获的RGB-D输入来测试框架. 然而,AdaMPI32在7-场景上实现了较低的LPIPS.

blocks.en: Figure 3 compares identical source–target pairs. At 3.5 ∘ 3.5^{\circ} , residual refinement reduces errors around object boundaries relative to Pure Warp. At 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} , it improves PSNR while visible distortions remain, illustrating the difficulty of correcting larger viewpoint changes from a single source.
blocks.zh: 图3比较了相同的源-目标对. 在3.5 ∘ 3.5 ^{\ Circ},剩余精度会减少对象边界周围相对于纯曲面的错误. 在15 ∘ 15 ^{\ Circ},它改进了 PSNR,而可见的扭曲仍然存在,说明了从单一来源纠正较大观点变化的困难.

blocks.en: Table 1 reports query latency of 0.95–0.98 ms for Ours, with a 14.4 MiB source cache and 95.8 MiB peak allocated memory. Source reuse shares feature extraction and geometry preparation across queries; target-dependent reprojection and residual prediction remain necessary for each new view.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We presented a per-scene framework for local view synthesis by reusing rendered RGB-D images without rerendering the scene. Relative-pose-guided warping preserves shared content, while multiscale residual refinement corrects transport errors and infers missing appearance. Experiments on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency, and GS-render ablations support the benefit of residual refinement. These findings highlight image reuse as a practical approach to responsive scene navigation, with potential AR/VR applications. Performance declines with larger viewpoint changes; extending the supported range and enabling cross-scene generalization remain future work.
blocks.zh: 我们通过重用渲染的 RGB-D 图像而不重置场景, 呈现了局部视图合成的平面框架 。 相对可控制导的wiping保留了共享内容,而多尺度的剩余精度则纠正了运输错误并推断出缺失外观. 对捕捉和制作场景的实验显示,查询延迟度较低,GS-reservation支持剩余改进的好处。 这些发现突出表明了图像再利用是应对场景导航的一种实用方法,具有潜在的AR/VR应用. 业绩下降,随着更大的观点变化;扩大所支持的范围并促成跨场面的普及仍然是今后的工作。
